name: AbstainEQA
summary: 评测具身问答智能体在证据不足时能否正确拒答的轨迹与问答基准。
summaryEn: An embodied question-answering benchmark testing whether agents abstain appropriately when trajectory evidence is insufficient.
scale: Episode histories and answerable/unanswerable QA over HM3D and ScanNet
scaleZh: 基于 HM3D 和 ScanNet 回合历史的可回答与不可回答问答
license: MIT code; HM3D and ScanNet terms apply
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT；HM3D 和 ScanNet 适用各自条款
access: QA files and frame-extraction utilities available; source assets require separate access
accessZh: 问答文件和帧提取工具可用，源素材需分别申请访问
verdict: 用拒答决策衡量智能体对自身世界证据边界的认知
verdictEn: Measures whether agents recognize the limits of their available world evidence
wmNote: 回合历史与拒答标签可用于研究不确定性和部分可观测状态。
wmNoteEn: Episode histories and abstention labels support uncertainty research under partial observability.
